name: MLS Projection
aliases: MLS projection via Hermite Point Set Surfaces
definition: An iterative algorithm to project a query point onto a surface defined by a set of input points and normals, fitting a local quadratic function.
summary: MLS Projection iteratively projects points onto surfaces using Moving Least Squares with Hermite data, refining positions and normals by minimizing distances to neighbor tangent planes for noise smoothing.
